package wiki.outside; import com.google.gson.JsonObject; import java.util.Arrays; import java.util.Collections; import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.HashSet; import java.util.Map; import java.util.Set; /** * What they're doing, as RuneLite's own Discord plugin shows it (11/16/2026, the Plugin Hub's answer: "matching Discord * activity should be okay"; ghillie's claude/outstation.md, "What RuneLite's Discord plugin shares"; * docs/protocol.md, "The snapshot"), never more: *
    *
  • the skill being trained: the player's own experience going up (the first reading of each skill after a login only * remembered), shown till 5 minutes pass with no more of it, Slayer and Fishing above the rest; any skill but * Hitpoints, which Discord's never names;
    • *
  • the area by Discord's own name and group (AREAS: its DiscordGameEventType's areas and regions, written here by * plugin/discord_areas.py), read at each scene load from the region the player stands in, an instance's as its template * lies; Nightmare Zone's region on the ground floor (the King Black Dragon's lair) as no area, as Discord has it;
    • *
  • a new scene clears the skill, as Discord's area event does.
    • *
* Less than Discord: no time or version; on a PvP or Deadman world, in the Wilderness or a PvP area, neither (both null, * "in game", as an area off the list), cleared at once. Sent only as it changes, at most once a minute (the latest when * the minute's up). With an area, one fixed point of it for the globe (at): the region of it nearest its regions' * middle (underground as the place above it, as following counts it), or off the map its entrance (ENTRANCES, * following's own), or none. The point is a function of the name, so it never says more than the name does. * Kept apart from RuneLite so it can be tested. */ final class Presence { static final String BOSS = "boss", CITY = "city", DUNGEON = "dungeon", MINIGAME = "minigame", RAID = "raid", REGION = "region"; /** a skill shows this long after its last experience drop (Discord's "Activity timeout": 5 minutes by default) */ static final long SKILL_MS = 5 * 60_000L; /** a change goes at most this often (the latest when it's up); clearing somewhere dangerous goes at once */ static final long EVERY_MS = 60_000L; /** Nightmare Zone's region, which the King Black Dragon's lair shares on the ground floor */ static final int NMZ = 9033; /** the skills Discord names (all but Hitpoints and the total) */ static final
